title: Rebar and the Alvord Lake Bridge

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: There's a well-known literary technique called Chekhov's gun, named after the Russian playwright.
sentences.zh: 有一种著名的文学技巧叫“契诃夫之枪”，是以这位俄国剧作家的名字命名的。

sentences.en: Basically, if a gun appears in the first act, it better be fired in the following act.
sentences.zh: 简单来说，如果第一幕里出现了一把枪，那它在接下来的剧幕里就一定要响。

sentences.en: There are no unnecessary details.
sentences.zh: 没有多余的细节。

sentences.en: You see a gun, that gun gets used to shoot someone.
sentences.zh: 你看到一把枪，那把枪就得用来射杀某人。

sentences.en: I have a corollary principle of my own invention,
sentences.zh: 我自己发明了一个推论原则，

sentences.en: and it relates to movies where there is a scene at a construction site.
sentences.zh: 它与电影中出现建筑工地的场景有关。

sentences.en: And it is this.
sentences.zh: 它是这样的：

sentences.en: If on the screen you see an ugly shaft of exposed rebar,
sentences.zh: 如果你在屏幕上看到一根丑陋的、裸露的钢筋，

sentences.en: somebody is getting impaled.
sentences.zh: 那肯定有人要被刺穿了。

sentences.en: There's something about rebar that fascinates me.
sentences.zh: 钢筋这种东西总让我着迷。

sentences.en: If nothing else, because there are very few things that invoke a fear of being skewered.
sentences.zh: 至少是因为，很少有东西能让人产生被刺穿的恐惧感。

sentences.en: My pathological preoccupation with metal reinforcement bars dovetails nicely with a structure in San Francisco
sentences.zh: 我对金属钢筋的病态执念，恰好与旧金山的一处建筑不谋而合，

sentences.en: I've kind of become obsessed with.
sentences.zh: 我对此有点着迷了。

sentences.en: A tiny bridge in Golden Gate Park.
sentences.zh: 那是金门公园里的一座小桥。

sentences.en: This is the Alfred Lake Bridge by Ernest Ransom.
sentences.zh: 这就是欧内斯特·兰瑟姆设计的阿尔瓦湖桥。

sentences.en: This is William Littman.
sentences.zh: 这位是威廉·利特曼。

sentences.en: He teaches architecture at the California College of the Arts,
sentences.zh: 他在加州艺术学院教授建筑学，

sentences.en: and he was the first person to tip me off to the importance of this humble little structure
sentences.zh: 他是第一个向我指出这座不起眼的小建筑的重要性的人，

sentences.en: on the very eastern edge of the park.
sentences.zh: 它就在公园的最东端。

sentences.en: It's sort of the entrance to the park from the hate side,
sentences.zh: 它算是从海特区进入公园的入口，

sentences.en: from the kind of hippie, slacker, hate area right at the edge of the park,
sentences.zh: 从公园边缘那种嬉皮士、懒汉聚集的海特区过来，

sentences.en: and sort of leading into the children's playground.
sentences.zh: 通往儿童游乐场。

sentences.en: It's not a place that most people really want to linger.
sentences.zh: 这不是大多数人真正想逗留的地方。

sentences.en: It is a spot for drug dealing and various illicit assignations.
sentences.zh: 这里是毒品交易和各种非法勾当的场所。

sentences.en: And that is Robert Corlin, author of Concrete Planet, giving us a lay of the land.
sentences.zh: 那位是《混凝土星球》的作者罗伯特·科林，正在为我们介绍当地情况。

sentences.en: We're in the Albert Lake Bridge, one of the earliest surviving reinforced concrete structures in the world.
sentences.zh: 我们现在位于阿尔瓦湖桥，这是世界上现存最早的钢筋混凝土结构之一。

sentences.en: The bridge was constructed in 1889.
sentences.zh: 这座桥建于1889年。

sentences.en: It may be the least appealing sort of monument of architecture or civil engineering.
sentences.zh: 它可能是建筑或土木工程中最不吸引人的纪念碑了。

sentences.en: On one side, it's cracked where the earth is sort of pressing through.
sentences.zh: 桥的一侧已经开裂，泥土正从裂缝中挤出来。

sentences.en: It's covered in mold and lichen.
sentences.zh: 上面覆盖着霉菌和地衣。

sentences.en: Inside, it's this kind of odd, surrealistic tunnel of stalactites that really kind of look like some sort of folk art,
sentences.zh: 内部是一个奇怪的、超现实的钟乳石隧道，看起来真像某种民间艺术，

sentences.en: you know, impression of what the surface of Mars might look like.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就像对火星表面样貌的某种印象。

sentences.en: I think it looks like the inside of a giant colon.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它看起来像巨型结肠的内部。

sentences.en: It's really unappealing to pass through it.
sentences.zh: 穿过它确实让人很不舒服。

sentences.en: It's not well kept up at all.
sentences.zh: 它一点也没得到妥善维护。

sentences.en: Well, there's nothing remarkable about it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，它没什么特别之处。

sentences.en: It is an arch, it's actually as much a pedestrian tunnel as a bridge.
sentences.zh: 它是一个拱门，实际上既是人行隧道也是桥梁。

sentences.en: A pioneering structure in the shape of a dumpy and neglected little bridge.
sentences.zh: 一个开创性的结构，却长得像一座破旧且被忽视的小桥。

sentences.en: But that's really sad because it is one of the pioneering buildings in the story of reinforced concrete.
sentences.zh: 但这真的很可悲，因为它是钢筋混凝土发展史上具有开创性的建筑之一。

sentences.en: There are plenty of candidates for the most overlooked, most invisible part of the built world,
sentences.zh: 关于建筑世界中最被忽视、最隐形的部分，有很多候选者，

sentences.en: but reinforced concrete has a good claim to being the most invisible of all.
sentences.zh: 但钢筋混凝土绝对有资格被称为最隐形的一个。

sentences.en: Because if it's made right, you never see the steel skeleton underneath all the concrete structures that you work in,
sentences.zh: 因为如果建造得当，你永远看不到你工作、

sentences.en: drive over, walk under.
sentences.zh: 开车经过、步行穿过的所有混凝土结构下的钢骨架。

sentences.en: Reinforced concrete is concrete that is strengthened by the addition of initially iron and then later steel to give it tinsel strength.
sentences.zh: 钢筋混凝土是指通过添加最初是铁、后来是钢来增强其抗拉强度的混凝土。

sentences.en: The thing about concrete is it's great in compression, meaning it withstands a lot of pressure in terms of, you know, weight.
sentences.zh: 混凝土的特点是抗压性极佳，意味着它能承受很大的重量压力。

sentences.en: But it's not very good in tension, meaning when you sort of spanning long distances, it sort of can collapse.
sentences.zh: 但它的抗拉性不太好，意味着当你跨越长距离时，它可能会坍塌。

sentences.en: So if you see concrete going high in the air or spanning a long distance, there is metal inside that.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你看到混凝土高耸入云或跨越长距离，里面一定有金属。

sentences.en: And you have this unassuming vanguard of a bridge and its engineer, Ernest Ransom, to thank for that.
sentences.zh: 而你要感谢这座不起眼的先锋桥梁及其工程师欧内斯特·兰瑟姆。

sentences.en: Ernest Ransom's principal claim to fame is that he's the father of modern reinforced concrete.
sentences.zh: 欧内斯特·兰瑟姆的主要成名之处在于他是现代钢筋混凝土之父。

sentences.en: The experiments done with reinforcing concrete with iron previous to Ernest Ransom were just one-off experiments.
sentences.zh: 在欧内斯特·兰瑟姆之前，用铁加固混凝土的实验都只是孤立的尝试。

sentences.en: A cottage in England, a house in New York, and a rowboat in France.
sentences.zh: 英国的一座小屋，纽约的一栋房子，法国的一艘划艇。

sentences.en: Ernest Ransom experimented with different forms of iron reinforcement until he hit upon what we now call rebar, which is short for reinforcement bar.
sentences.zh: 欧内斯特·兰瑟姆尝试了不同形式的铁加固，直到他发现了我们现在所说的“钢筋”（rebar，即reinforcement bar的缩写）。

sentences.en: And his technology was far beyond any of the others who were experimenting with reinforced concrete at the time.
sentences.zh: 他的技术远超当时其他尝试钢筋混凝土的人。

sentences.en: A lot of people in Europe and America are playing with putting in bars or metal into concrete at this time.
sentences.zh: 当时欧洲和美国的许多人都在尝试将钢筋或金属放入混凝土中。

sentences.en: There's many different techniques, and everyone's experimenting.
sentences.zh: 有很多不同的技术，每个人都在实验。

sentences.en: What Ransom's sort of major innovation is, is he takes a sort of square bar that runs through it, and he twists it slightly.
sentences.zh: 兰瑟姆的主要创新在于，他取了一根贯穿其中的方形钢筋，并将其稍微扭转。

sentences.en: And that gives it an adhesive quality to the concrete itself, and sort of stays together much better.
sentences.zh: 这赋予了它与混凝土本身的粘附性，使结构结合得更好。

sentences.en: Ransom said to come to this idea, he found a twisted rubber band in his pocket one day, and thought,
sentences.zh: 兰瑟姆说，他想到这个主意是因为有一天他在口袋里发现了一根扭曲的橡皮筋，心想，

sentences.en: well, that's what I'm going to do to this iron bar.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我也要对这根铁棒做同样的事。

sentences.en: I'm going to twist it, so it just binds to the concrete better.
sentences.zh: 我要把它扭转，这样它就能更好地与混凝土结合。

sentences.en: You can see a diagram of this twisted rebar in Ransom's 1884 patent.
sentences.zh: 你可以在兰瑟姆1884年的专利中看到这种扭曲钢筋的图示。

sentences.en: By the way, if you're anything like me, Google patent search is the best way to spend time in front of the computer.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，如果你像我一样，谷歌专利搜索是电脑前消磨时间的最佳方式。

sentences.en: I could lose hours jumping from patent to patent.
sentences.zh: 我可以在专利之间跳转，一坐就是几个小时。

sentences.en: Anyway, this innovation of messing with the bar to help it bond with the surrounding concrete is still used to this day.
sentences.zh: 总之，这种通过改变钢筋形状来帮助其与周围混凝土结合的创新，至今仍在使用。

sentences.en: We put deformations on the reinforcing bar so that the concrete will hold on to it.
sentences.zh: 我们在钢筋上制造变形，以便混凝土能牢牢抓住它。

sentences.en: That scoring is probably why I find rebar so ugly and unsettling.
sentences.zh: 那种刻痕可能就是我发现钢筋如此丑陋和令人不安的原因。

sentences.en: That's Bob Risser right there.
sentences.zh: 那位就是鲍勃·里瑟。

sentences.en: I'm Bob Risser.
sentences.zh: 我是鲍勃·里瑟。

sentences.en: I'm president and CEO of the Concrete Reinforcing Steel Institute.
sentences.zh: 我是混凝土钢筋协会的总裁兼首席执行官。

sentences.en: I called the C-R-S-I to get the full scope of what reinforced concrete means to the built world.
sentences.zh: 我致电混凝土钢筋协会（CRSI），以全面了解钢筋混凝土对建筑世界的意义。

sentences.en: Well, without reinforced concrete is that modern society is not possible without it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，没有钢筋混凝土，现代社会就不可能存在。

sentences.en: Well, as humble as the Albert Lake Bridge is, it is a direct precursor to the Ingalls skyscraper built just 15 years later in Cincinnati, Ohio,
sentences.zh: 虽然阿尔瓦湖桥很不起眼，但它是15年后在俄亥俄州辛辛那提建造的英格尔斯大厦的直接前身，

sentences.en: the world's first reinforced concrete skyscraper.
sentences.zh: 那是世界上第一座钢筋混凝土摩天大楼。

sentences.en: It also led to bridges, dams, freeways, streets of reinforced concrete.
sentences.zh: 它还催生了钢筋混凝土桥梁、大坝、高速公路和街道。

sentences.en: I mean, without reinforced concrete, you would only be able to build a series of unconnected asphalt roads.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，没有钢筋混凝土，你只能建造一系列互不相连的沥青路。

sentences.en: It's a very humble beginning, but it was from here in San Francisco that the reinforced concrete revolution took over the world.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常卑微的开端，但正是从旧金山这里，钢筋混凝土革命席卷了全球。

sentences.en: That's why we talk about it being the foundation of civilization.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们称其为文明的基石。

sentences.en: It's also a foundation of modern architecture.
sentences.zh: 它也是现代建筑的基石。

sentences.en: It made possible forms that were never possible before, like Frank Lloyd Wright's Guggenheim Museum and, more recently, Jeanne Gang's Aqua Tower in Chicago.
sentences.zh: 它使以前不可能实现的形态成为可能，比如弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特的古根海姆博物馆，以及最近芝加哥珍妮·甘的“水”大厦。

sentences.en: It's designed to mimic flowing water.
sentences.zh: 它的设计旨在模仿流动的河水。

sentences.en: On the 80-some floors, there's no two balconies that are the same.
sentences.zh: 在80多层楼里，没有两个阳台是完全一样的。

sentences.en: But the problem with reinforced concrete, especially if the rebar isn't covered with enough concrete and is exposed to water and salt,
sentences.zh: 但钢筋混凝土的问题在于，如果钢筋没有被足够的混凝土覆盖，并暴露在水和盐分中，

sentences.en: is that the steel inside can ruSt.
sentences.zh: 里面的钢材就会生锈。

sentences.en: And as it rusts, it expands.
sentences.zh: 随着生锈，它会膨胀。

sentences.en: It expands to almost fourfold its original diameter, destroying the concrete around it while the steel itself is being destroyed by the rust and corrosion.
sentences.zh: 它会膨胀到原始直径的近四倍，在钢材本身被锈蚀和腐蚀破坏的同时，也摧毁了周围的混凝土。

sentences.en: And when that happens, which it will eventually,
sentences.zh: 当这种情况发生时——而且最终一定会发生——

sentences.en: reinforced concrete doesn't last the 1,000 years that Ernest Ransom and the early reinforced concrete proponents thought that it would.
sentences.zh: 钢筋混凝土并不能像欧内斯特·兰瑟姆和早期钢筋混凝土倡导者所认为的那样维持1000年。

sentences.en: The design life was about 50 years.
sentences.zh: 其设计寿命约为50年。

sentences.en: The entire interstate system was built under the assumption of a 50-year design.
sentences.zh: 整个州际公路系统都是基于50年的设计假设建造的。

sentences.en: These days, our organization and others are working with the federal government and state agencies to try to look at 75 and even 100-year designs.
sentences.zh: 如今，我们组织和其他机构正在与联邦政府和州政府机构合作，试图研究75年甚至100年的设计。

sentences.en: Modern reinforced concrete frames encased inside of a building superstructure with normal maintenance will last a lot, lot longer.
sentences.zh: 包裹在建筑上层结构中的现代钢筋混凝土框架，在正常维护下，寿命会长得多。

sentences.en: So don't worry, the Burr Khalifa, the tallest tower in the world and the tallest reinforced concrete structure is not coming down anytime soon.
sentences.zh: 所以别担心，哈利法塔，这座世界最高塔和最高的钢筋混凝土结构，不会很快倒塌。

sentences.en: But the clock is ticking for most of the reinforced concrete infrastructure that was put up in the middle of the 20th century in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但对于美国20世纪中期建造的大多数钢筋混凝土基础设施来说，时间已经不多了。

sentences.en: People have to realize that all this that they see around them will eventually have to be, with a few exceptions,
sentences.zh: 人们必须意识到，除了少数例外，他们周围所看到的一切最终都必须，

sentences.en: will have to be torn down and replaced because we built with steel reinforced concrete.
sentences.zh: 都必须拆除并更换，因为我们是用钢筋混凝土建造的。

sentences.en: And the cost of that, it will be trillions of dollars, an unbelievable amount of money.
sentences.zh: 而其成本将是数万亿美元，这是一个令人难以置信的数字。

sentences.en: Seriously, the stuff that wasn't properly maintained is coming down.
sentences.zh: 说真的，那些没有得到妥善维护的东西正在倒塌。

sentences.en: And as you can imagine, a lot of our infrastructure was not properly maintained.
sentences.zh: 正如你所能想象的那样，我们的许多基础设施都没有得到妥善维护。

sentences.en: Very frankly, the method has been and in some cases still is, you know, a reactionary policy rather than a well-thought-out maintenance routine.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，过去的方法一直，在某些情况下现在仍然是，一种反应式的政策，而不是深思熟虑的维护程序。

sentences.en: Even though concrete has the illusion of permanence, it is not that way at all.
sentences.zh: 尽管混凝土给人一种永恒的错觉，但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: You don't just build it and forget it.
sentences.zh: 你不能只管建造而不去管它。

sentences.en: You have to account for going back and taking care of it like you would anything else.
sentences.zh: 你必须考虑像对待其他任何东西一样回去照顾它。

sentences.en: Ernest Ransom left San Francisco soon after he completed the Alvar Lake Bridge.
sentences.zh: 欧内斯特·兰瑟姆在完成阿尔瓦湖桥后不久就离开了旧金山。

sentences.en: In his book, Reinforced Concrete Buildings, published in 1912, which is not the most scintillating of texts,
sentences.zh: 在他1912年出版的《钢筋混凝土建筑》一书中，虽然这不是什么引人入胜的文本，

sentences.en: but in it, you can detect a tinge of bitterness in Ransom's words, as he describes how his twisted rebar was, quote,
sentences.zh: 但你可以在其中察觉到兰瑟姆言语中流露出的苦涩，他描述了他的扭曲钢筋是如何被，引用他的话，

sentences.en: laughed down by the technical society in California.
sentences.zh: “被加州的专业协会嘲笑”。

sentences.en: He left for the East, thinking that his revolution of reinforced concrete would have a better chance out there.
sentences.zh: 他去了东方，认为他的钢筋混凝土革命在那里会有更好的机会。

sentences.en: He left thinking that no one here would fully appreciate his Alvar Lake Bridge,
sentences.zh: 他离开时认为这里没有人会充分欣赏他的阿尔瓦湖桥，

sentences.en: that no one here would appreciate this literal bridge to the modern world.
sentences.zh: 认为这里没有人会欣赏这座通往现代世界的真正桥梁。

sentences.en: And looking at it today, I'm sad to say that he was right.
sentences.zh: 今天再看它，我很遗憾地说，他是对的。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible is Sam Greenspan and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 《99%隐形》由萨姆·格林斯潘和我，罗曼·马尔斯制作。

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7 Local Public Radio KALW in San Francisco
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山91.7本地公共广播电台KALW的一个项目，

sentences.en: and the American Institute of Architects in San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 以及旧金山美国建筑师协会的项目。

sentences.en: You can find the show and like the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在Facebook上找到并关注这个节目。

sentences.en: I tweet at Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我的推特账号是Roman Mars。

sentences.en: But this week, oh my goodness, we have amazing photographs of the Alvar Lake Bridge.
sentences.zh: 但本周，天哪，我们有阿尔瓦湖桥的精彩照片。

sentences.en: That's photographed by Eddie Joaquim.
sentences.zh: 那是埃迪·乔阿金拍摄的。

sentences.en: He just makes the ugliness and creepiness of that place look beautiful and stunning.
sentences.zh: 他让那个地方的丑陋和诡异看起来既美丽又震撼。

sentences.en: You have to check them out.
sentences.zh: 你一定要去看看。

sentences.en: They're at 99percentinvisible.org.
sentences.zh: 网址是99percentinvisible.org。

sentences.en: Videotopia.
sentences.zh: Videotopia。
